elements.notes:
¹See Import Sources (2019–22).
²Exports are reported free alongside ship (f.a.s.) U.S. ports.
³Shipments from Government stockpile are for the Defense Logistics Agency.
⁴Apparent consumption is production plus imports minus exports plus or minus stock changes.
⁵Price is for beryllium content in beryllium-copper master alloy.
⁶Net import reliance is imports minus exports as a percentage of apparent consumption.
E = Value estimated; NA = Not available.
